lines.en: I decide to spend the night hanging out with Otoha in her room.
lines.zh: 我决定今晚留在 Otoha 房间里陪她待着。

lines.en: Without much for the two of us to do around here, I manage to coerce her into playing a few songs for me.
lines.zh: 这附近没什么我们俩能做的事，我总算哄得她给我弹了几首歌。

lines.en: She's a bit bashful about it at first since it's apparently weird to just play and sing for one guy in her room.
lines.zh: 她一开始有点害羞，因为据说在房间里只为一个男生弹琴唱歌，是件挺怪的事。

lines.en: I get that. It definitely is weird.
But we manage to counteract the discomfort by eighty-sixing the vocals and just maintaining different sorts of conversations while she strums away.
lines.zh: 不过我们靠着一个办法化解了那份别扭——把人声部分整个砍掉，只在她拨弦的时候聊些各种各样的话题。

lines.en: We talk about all sorts of things, none of them being noteworthy, as the sun is slowly overtaken by the moon.
lines.zh: 我们天南海北地聊，没有一件值得一提，而太阳也在不知不觉间被月亮取代。

lines.en: Before we know it, it's almost midnight.
lines.zh: 等我们反应过来，已经快午夜了。

lines.en: I try to get Otoha to play an encore for me, {i}with{/i} vocals this time-
lines.zh: 我想让 Otoha 再为我安可一首，这次{i}带{/i}人声——

lines.en: But she promptly kicks me out of the room and tells me I'll need to come see her perform elsewhere if I want a real show.
lines.zh: : 可她干脆把我踢出了房间，说我要是想看真正的演出，就得去别的地方看她表演。

lines.en: I'm perfectly content for what I {i}did{/i} get to see.
lines.zh: : 对于我{i}确实{/i}看到的东西，我心满意足。

lines.en: Because I realize that no one else will ever see it.
lines.zh: 因为我意识到，再也没有别人会看到它。

lines.en: And exclusivity is one of my favorite things in the world when I am the one benefiting from it.
lines.zh: 而当受益的那个人是我的时候，独占可是这世上我最喜欢的东西之一。
